case.title: The Midnight Heist
case.introduction: The night was dark at Ashcroft Hall. A priceless gem vanished from the vault. One guest hides a fake name. You must find the thief.
case.crime: The diamond was stolen from the vault.
case.escape_plan: The thief will use the secret tunnel to leave the hall. They will meet a contact outside the gate at sunrise.

rooms.name: Entrance Hall
rooms.description: The main hall. A big staircase. Portraits on the walls.

rooms.name: Vault
rooms.description: A dark room with a safe. Heavy metal door.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Rows of books. A secret lever in the desk.

rooms.name: Garden
rooms.description: Night garden with a stone path. A hidden gate.

rooms.name: Trophy Room
rooms.description: Paintings and trophies. A locked cabinet.

characters.name: Ethan Blake
characters.background: He moved to the city a year ago. He likes to talk about travel. He has no family here. He is nervous about meeting strangers.
characters.secret: He is not really Ethan Blake. His real name is Marcus Lee.
characters.goal: Hide his identity and keep the gem.
characters.alibi: He says he was in the library reading. He was alone.
characters.habits: He likes to chew gum. He watches the clock often.
characters.fear: He fears being caught by the police.
knowledge: He knows the lock of the vault. He knows the tunnel.
lies: He says he was alone in the library.

characters.name: Lila Grant
characters.background: She is a local painter. She loves animals. She has a pet cat.
characters.secret: She has a tattoo of a rose on her wrist that she hides from others.
characters.goal: Finish her art. Keep her privacy.
characters.alibi: She says she was in the garden painting. She was alone.
characters.speaking_style: Fast voice. She talks a lot.
characters.habits: She taps her fingers. She always checks her phone.
characters.fear: She fears her art will be stolen.

relationships.detail: They saw each other at a gallery.

knowledge: She knows the layout of the garden. She knows about the secret gate.
lies: She says she was alone in the garden.

characters.name: Marcus Lee
characters.background: He runs a small restaurant. He loves cooking. He has a small family.
characters.secret: He knows the vault key. He has a secret recipe.
characters.goal: Win a culinary award. Keep his restaurant popular.
characters.alibi: He says he was cooking in the kitchen. He was alone.
characters.habits: He wears a chef's hat. He hums while cooking.
knowledge: He knows the safe's code. He knows how to open it.
lies: He says he was alone in the kitchen.

characters.name: Nina Patel
characters.background: She works for the city. She loves puzzles. She has a badge.
characters.secret: She hides a scar on her cheek.
characters.goal: Solve the case. Keep the city safe.
characters.alibi: She says she was in the trophy room looking at paintings. She was alone.
characters.habits: She always keeps her notebook. She checks her watch often.
knowledge: She knows the layout of the trophy room. She knows how to trace fingerprints.
lies: She says she was alone in the trophy room.

characters.name: Tom Ruiz
characters.background: He fixes cars. He likes to talk. He has a friend group.
characters.secret: He has a secret stash of tools hidden in his toolbox.
characters.goal: Make money. Keep his tools safe.
characters.alibi: He says he was in the garage fixing a bike. He was alone.
characters.habits: He always carries a wrench. He talks loudly.
knowledge: He knows how to open the garage door. He knows where the tools are.
lies: He says he was alone in the garage.

timeline.description: Guests arrive. The gem is shown in the vault.

evidence.name: Broken Key
evidence.description: A key that was broken in half. It was in the vault door. It looks new.

evidence.name: Footprints
evidence.description: Small footprints on the stone path. They match a shoe size 9.

evidence.name: Gum Wrapper
evidence.description: A wrapper from a gum pack. It was left in the library.

evidence.name: Tattoo
evidence.description: A small rose on a wrist. It is hidden under a long sleeve.

hidden_clues: The broken key is too new. The gum wrapper is from the same brand the thief likes.
The footprints are from a size that no guest owns.
red_herrings: Footprints point to C3. The rose tattoo is a clue for C2.

solution.reasoning: The gum wrapper shows C1 likes gum. The broken key is new and in the vault. The real Marcus Lee knows the key and the vault. C1 is the fake name Ethan Blake.

state.current_objective: 5 guests. One fake identity. It happened at Ashcroft Hall. Search the rooms, talk to everyone, and find the person behind the diamond was stolen from the vault. Some guests lie. Check their stories carefully.
